LNG_UPSTREAM_SERVER_FIELD_LABEL_URL_DESC.translation: Address of the API of the other Go.Data instance, the one that will receive the data. It must end with /api. Example: http://localhost:3000/api

LNG_UPSTREAM_SERVER_FIELD_LABEL_TIMEOUT_.translation: Time limit, in milliseconds, for each request made to this server. Use 0 for no limit.

LNG_UPSTREAM_SERVER_FIELD_LABEL_SYNC_INT.translation: Interval, in hours, between automatic synchronizations. Use 0 to disable the automatic synchronization.

LNG_UPSTREAM_SERVER_FIELD_LABEL_SYNC_ENA.translation: When disabled, this server is ignored by the manual, automatic and on every change synchronizations.

LNG_UPSTREAM_SERVER_FIELD_LABEL_CREDENTI.translation: Client ID created in the "Receive data from servers" page of the other Go.Data instance.
Client secret created in the "Receive data from servers" page of the other Go.Data instance.
